payingUser: An independent hair colourist or salon owner who mixes colour for regular clients and keeps the formula on paper or in a phone note.
paidUnit: A one-time unlock of unlimited client formula cards with before and after photos, per-client history, and a printable formula card.
momentOfPayment: When the colourist tries to save the third client formula card, after the first two are stored for free.
